enterChangeClearResetBehavior.beatEntry: enterEmergentStoryBeat: runtime.latches.clear(), runtime.elapsed = 0, resetFlightGuidanceDwell(), clearGuidedStoryObjective(), resetAuditRoute(), then the per-beat switch, then syncEmergentObjectiveGuidance(), then enterSignedSceneAvBeat().
enterChangeClearResetBehavior.objectiveChange: only when the derived objective ID changes; marker label / work-order changes under an unchanged ID are silently dropped.
enterChangeClearResetBehavior.objectiveClear: clearGuidedStoryObjective() at every beat boundary. HUD text is beat-owned afterwards.
enterChangeClearResetBehavior.signedAvReset: reset triggers beat-exit, deep-link, replay, pause, quit, focus-loss, completion, sandbox; ch7/ch8 shots reference reset-camera, reset-grade, reset-lighting, reset-effects, reset-score. lastResetReason observed as 'beat-exit' after each ch7/ch8 boundary.
enterChangeClearResetBehavior.deepLink: ?story= plus a beat id resets the debug story run, seeds prerequisites (storyState.seedForBeat), clears both worlds' voxel edits and poses, sets reality stage, then publishes the beat. ?story=ch8-launch additionally runs bootstrapOriginLaunchDebug().
enterChangeClearResetBehavior.snapshotRestore: ?keep=1 (set only by the snapshot restore path, main/src/game/systems/storySnapshot.ts) skips the pristine reset so a restored durable snapshot boots as-is.
enterChangeClearResetBehavior.captionOnBeatChange: captions are NOT cleared at a beat boundary; the previous caption keeps counting down its ttl until the next showCaption overwrites it. Observed: ch7-reconstruct's exit caption was replaced mid-typewriter by ch7-board's entry caption 0.2 s later.
enterChangeClearResetBehavior.replayReset: restartStory() calls clearStoryText(), which nulls caption/system/audit and empties workorder/violation.
